headlines.title: Trump Threatens China With More Tariffs Ahead of Final Trade Talks
headlines.abstract: The president’s threat was aimed at forcing Beijing to agree to a final trade deal on America’s terms this week in Washington.

headlines.title: Trump escalates trade war with China with plan to raise tariffs
Markets slide after Trump threatens to dramatically increase China tariffs
Trump’s Trade War Threat Poses Problems for China and Investors
headlines.abstract: Amid uncertainly over trade talks set to take place this week, economists and investors worry that new tariffs would stop China’s economic recovery.

headlines.title: Trump Advisers Accuse China of Reneging on Trade Commitments
headlines.abstract: A trade war that seemed to be on the brink of ending now appears likely to be prolonged as President Trump threatens to impose more tariffs on China.
